questions.questionText: Find the next letter in the series: B, E, H, K, N, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves forward by 3 positions: B(2) + 3 = E(5); E(5) + 3 = H(8); H(8) + 3 = K(11); K(11) + 3 = N(14). Next letter is N(14) + 3 = Q(17).

questions.questionText: What is the missing cluster in the series: AZ, CX, EV, GT, ?
questions.explanation: First letter increases by +2: A, C, E, G -> I. Second letter decreases by -2: Z, X, V, T -> R. (Also, each pair consists of opposite letters: A-Z, C-X, E-V, G-T, I-R). Next cluster is IR.

questions.questionText: Identify the next term: D, H, L, P, T, ?
questions.explanation: Letters advance by 4 steps: D(4) + 4 = H(8); H(8) + 4 = L(12); L(12) + 4 = P(16); P(16) + 4 = T(20). Next letter is T(20) + 4 = X(24).

questions.questionText: Which letter combination sequentially fills the gaps in the letter series: a b _ a b _ b _ a b _ b
questions.explanation: The sequence of 12 letters is formed by repeating the 3-letter block "a b b" four times: "a b b | a b b | a b b | a b b". The letters missing at the blanks in order are b, b, a, a.

questions.questionText: Find the next term in the sequence: Z, W, S, N, ?
questions.explanation: Differences between alphabet positions: Z(26) - 3 = W(23); W(23) - 4 = S(19); S(19) - 5 = N(14). The decrement increases by 1 each time (-3, -4, -5, -6). Next letter is N(14) - 6 = H(8).

questions.questionText: Determine the missing group: BCD, FGH, JKL, ?
questions.explanation: Each group contains 3 consecutive letters. First letters: B(2) + 4 = F(6); F(6) + 4 = J(10); J(10) + 4 = N(14). Followed by next two consecutive letters: N, O, P. Next group is NOP.

questions.questionText: What comes next in the sequence: A, C, F, J, O, ?
Find the next pair: BF, CH, DJ, EL, ?
questions.explanation: First letter advances by 1: B, C, D, E -> F. Second letter advances by 2: F(6), H(8), J(10), L(12) -> N(14). Next pair is FN.

questions.questionText: Identify the missing term: Y, B, W, D, U, F, S, ?
questions.explanation: Two interleaved series: Series 1 (odd positions): Y(25), W(23), U(21), S(19) (-2 each time). Series 2 (even positions): B(2), D(4), F(6), ? (+2 each time). Next letter is F(6) + 2 = H(8).

questions.questionText: What is the next cluster: CBA, FED, IHG, LKJ, ?
questions.explanation: Each group consists of 3 consecutive letters in reverse order. First letters: C(3) + 3 = F(6); F(6) + 3 = I(9); I(9) + 3 = L(12); L(12) + 3 = O(15). Reversing O, N, M gives ONM.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter in the prime-indexed series: B, C, E, G, K, M, ?
questions.explanation: The alphabet indices correspond to prime numbers: B(2), C(3), E(5), G(7), K(11), M(13). The next prime number is 17, which corresponds to Q.

questions.questionText: Fill in the missing term: DF, GJ, KM, NQ, RT, ?
questions.explanation: Let us analyze pairs: D(4) and F(6) [diff 2]; G(7) and J(10) [diff 3]; K(11) and M(13) [diff 2]; N(14) and Q(17) [diff 3]; R(18) and T(20) [diff 2]. Notice gap between pairs: F(6)->G(7) [+1]; J(10)->K(11) [+1]; Q(17)->R(18) [+1]. From T(20), +1 gives U(21). The internal difference alternates between 2 and 3; next is diff 3. U(21) + 3 = X(24). Result is UX.

questions.questionText: What comes next in the sequence: A, E, I, M, Q, ?
Determine the missing group: PER, QFS, RGT, SHU, ?
questions.explanation: First letter: P, Q, R, S -> T. Second letter: E, F, G, H -> I. Third letter: R, S, T, U -> V. Next group is TIV.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: Z, X, U, Q, L, ?
Which letter completes the pattern: B, D, G, K, P, ?
Identify the next pair: DW, EV, FU, GT, ?
questions.explanation: First letters advance: D, E, F, G -> H. Second letters move backward: W, V, U, T -> S. Each pair consists of letters that sum to 27 (complementary letters). Next pair is HS.

questions.questionText: Find the missing term: AB, DE, GH, JK, ?
questions.explanation: Pairs of consecutive letters with a 1-letter gap between pairs: AB (skip C), DE (skip F), GH (skip I), JK (skip L). Next pair is MN.

questions.questionText: What is the next letter in the sequence: C, F, I, L, O, R, ?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 3: C(3), F(6), I(9), L(12), O(15), R(18). Next letter is 21 = U.

questions.questionText: Determine the missing cluster: B2D, D4F, F8H, H16J, ?
questions.explanation: First letters: B, D, F, H -> J (+2). Numbers double: 2, 4, 8, 16 -> 32. Last letters: D, F, H, J -> L (+2). Next cluster is J32L.
questions.concept: Dual Letter Step with Geometric Integer Core

questions.questionText: Find the next term in the series: CX, FU, IR, LO, ?
questions.explanation: First letter advances by 3: C(3)+3=F(6); F(6)+3=I(9); I(9)+3=L(12); L(12)+3=O(15). Second letter decreases by 3: X(24)-3=U(21); U(21)-3=R(18); R(18)-3=O(15); O(15)-3=L(12). Next term is OL.

questions.questionText: Identify the missing term: W, T, P, M, I, ?
questions.explanation: Differences alternate between -3 and -4: W(23)-3=T(20); T(20)-4=P(16); P(16)-3=M(13); M(13)-4=I(9). Next decrement is -3: I(9)-3=F(6).

questions.questionText: What comes next in the sequence: BE, GJ, LO, QT, ?
questions.explanation: Internal gap: B(2) to E(5) is +3; G(7) to J(10) is +3; L(12) to O(15) is +3; Q(17) to T(20) is +3. First letters advance by 5: B(2)+5=G(7); G(7)+5=L(12); L(12)+5=Q(17); Q(17)+5=V(22). Second letter: V(22)+3=Y(25). Result is VY.
questions.subTopic: Constant Internal Gap with Regular Shift

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: A, D, I, P, ?
questions.explanation: Positions are square numbers: A = 1^2 = 1; D = 2^2 = 4; I = 3^2 = 9; P = 4^2 = 16. Next term = 5^2 = 25, which corresponds to Y.

questions.questionText: Determine the missing group: AC, EG, IK, MO, ?
questions.explanation: Each group consists of two letters with a gap of 1 (alternate letters). First letters skip by 4: A(1), E(5), I(9), M(13) -> Q(17). The pair is Q, S.

questions.questionText: Which cluster completes the series: ZA, YB, XC, WD, ?
questions.explanation: First letter counts backward: Z, Y, X, W -> V. Second letter counts forward: A, B, C, D -> E. Next cluster is VE.

questions.questionText: Find the missing term: CBA, IHG, ONM, UTSR? Wait: CBA, GFE, KJI, ONM, ?
questions.explanation: Groups of 3 descending letters. First letter advances by 4: C(3)+4=G(7); G(7)+4=K(11); K(11)+4=O(15); O(15)+4=S(19). The 3 descending letters starting with S are S, R, Q.
questions.concept: Shift of Four with Descending Blocks

questions.questionText: What comes next in the sequence: D, G, K, P, V, ?
questions.explanation: Gaps: D(4)+3=G(7); G(7)+4=K(11); K(11)+5=P(16); P(16)+6=V(22). Next step is +7: V(22) + 7 = 29. Wrapping around 26: 29 - 26 = 3, which corresponds to C.

questions.questionText: Identify the missing term: AB, EF, IJ, MN, ?
questions.explanation: Consecutive pairs skipping 2 letters between them: AB (skip CD), EF (skip GH), IJ (skip KL), MN (skip OP). Next pair is QR.
questions.subTopic: Two-Letter Consecutive Blocks with Two-Letter Skip

questions.questionText: Determine the next cluster: AI, BJ, CK, DL, ?
questions.explanation: First letter advances by 1: A, B, C, D -> E. Second letter is 8 positions ahead of the first: A(1)+8=I(9); B(2)+8=J(10); C(3)+8=K(11); D(4)+8=L(12). For E(5): 5+8=M(13). Result is EM.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: JAZ, LEX, NIV, POT, ?
questions.explanation: First letter: J(10), L(12), N(14), P(16) -> R(18) [+2]. Middle letter: A(1), E(5), I(9), O(15) -> consecutive vowels! Next vowel after O is U? Wait, middle letters: A, E, I, O -> next vowel is U. Let's check options: if vowels, then RUR. If middle letter advances by 4: A(+4)=E(+4)=I(+6)=O? Wait, A(1), E(5), I(9), O(15) is vowels. If middle letter is Q: A, E, I, O, U. If RUR is not present, let us check: J(+2)L(+2)N(+2)P(+2)R. Third letter: Z(26), X(24), V(22), T(20) -> R(18) [-2]. If middle letter is vowel: U -> RUR. If RUR is option, then RUR is clean.
questions.concept: Vowel Center with Dual Consonant Shifts

questions.questionText: What is the next letter in the sequence: C, E, H, L, Q, ?
Identify the missing term: BCF, EHI, HKL, ?
questions.explanation: First letter advances by 3: B(2)+3=E(5); E(5)+3=H(8); H(8)+3=K(11). In each group, first to second is +1, second to third is +3: B(2)+1=C(3)+3=F(6); E(5)+1=H? No, E(5)->H(8)->I(9). Look at first letters: B(2), E(5), H(8) -> K(11). Look at second letters: C(3), H(8), K(11)? Look at: B(+1)=C(+3)=F. E(+3)=H(+1)=I. H(+3)=K(+1)=L. First letters are B(2), E(5), H(8) -> K(11). Pattern of inner offsets: (+1, +3), (+3, +1), (+3, +1)... Next: K(+1)=L(+3)=O gives KLO? If K(+3)=N(+1)=O gives KNO! BCF, EHI, HKL -> next is KNO.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: K, I, G, E, C, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves backward by 2 steps: K(11)-2=I(9); I(9)-2=G(7); G(7)-2=E(5); E(5)-2=C(3). Next letter is C(3)-2=A(1).

questions.questionText: Determine the missing pair: GT, IR, KP, MN, ?
questions.explanation: First letter advances by 2: G(7), I(9), K(11), M(13) -> O(15). Second letter decreases by 2: T(20), R(18), P(16), N(14) -> L(12). Next pair is OL.

questions.questionText: What comes next in the sequence: A, C, E, G, I, ?
questions.explanation: Consecutive odd-positioned letters of the alphabet: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9. The next odd position is 11, corresponding to K.

questions.questionText: Identify the missing cluster in the series: BDFH, CFIL, DHLP, ?
questions.explanation: The letters in each 4-letter cluster are multiples of their group number: Group 1 uses multiples of 2: B(2), D(4), F(6), H(8). Group 2 uses multiples of 3: C(3), F(6), I(9), L(12). Group 3 uses multiples of 4: D(4), H(8), L(12), P(16). Therefore, Group 4 uses multiples of 5: E(5), J(10), O(15), T(20) -> EJOT.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: Y, U, Q, M, I, ?
questions.explanation: Letters decrease by 4 steps each: Y(25)-4=U(21); U(21)-4=Q(17); Q(17)-4=M(13); M(13)-4=I(9). Next letter is I(9)-4 = E(5).

questions.questionText: What is the missing cluster: Q1F, S2E, U6D, W24C, ?
questions.explanation: First letter: Q(17)+2=S(19)+2=U(21)+2=W(23)+2=Y(25). Numbers: Factorials! 1!=1, 2!=2, 3!=6, 4!=24, 5!=120. Last letter: F, E, D, C -> B (-1). Result is Y120B.
questions.concept: Two Letter Streams with Embedded Factorials

questions.questionText: Determine the next term: A, Z, B, Y, C, X, ?
questions.explanation: Interleaved series: Odd positions advance from the beginning: A, B, C -> D. Even positions count backward from the end: Z, Y, X. Position 7 is an odd position, so the next letter is D.

questions.questionText: Find the missing term in the sequence: AD, EH, IL, MP, ?
questions.explanation: Each group has an internal step of +3: A(1)+3=D(4); E(5)+3=H(8); I(9)+3=L(12); M(13)+3=P(16). First letters advance by 4: A, E, I, M -> Q(17). Q(17) + 3 = T(20). Result is QT.
questions.concept: Constant Internal Gap with Periodic Skip

questions.questionText: What is the next letter: B, D, H, P, ?
questions.explanation: Letter positions double each step: B(2)*2 = D(4); D(4)*2 = H(8); H(8)*2 = P(16). Next position is 16 * 2 = 32. Wrap around 26: 32 - 26 = 6, which corresponds to F.
questions.concept: Power of Two with Alphabet Modulo 26

questions.questionText: Identify the missing cluster: PMT, OOS, NQR, MSQ, ?
Find the next letter in the series: A, C, G, M, ?
questions.explanation: Increments between positions: A(1) to C(3) is +2; C(3) to G(7) is +4; G(7) to M(13) is +6. Next increment is +8: M(13) + 8 = U(21).

questions.questionText: What comes next in the sequence: C2E, E5H, H10L, L17Q, ?
questions.explanation: First letter matches previous group's last letter: C -> E -> H -> L -> Q. Numbers: n^2 + 1: 1^2+1=2; 2^2+1=5; 3^2+1=10; 4^2+1=17; 5^2+1=26. Internal letter gap: C(3)+2=E(5); E(5)+3=H(8); H(8)+4=L(12); L(12)+5=Q(17); Q(17)+6=W(23). Next cluster is Q26W.

questions.questionText: Determine the missing term: X, U, Q, N, J, ?
questions.explanation: Pattern of decrements: X(24)-3=U(21); U(21)-4=Q(17); Q(17)-3=N(14); N(14)-4=J(10). Alternating decrements of -3 and -4. Next decrement is -3: J(10) - 3 = G(7).

questions.questionText: Identify the next term: BCA, FGE, JKI, ?
questions.explanation: First letter advances by 4: B(2)+4=F(6); F(6)+4=J(10); J(10)+4=N(14). In each group, structure is (n+1, n+2, n): B(2), C(3), A(1); F(6), G(7), E(5); J(10), K(11), I(9). For N(14), the group is N(14), O(15), M(13) -> NOM? Wait: (n+1) -> for B(2), B is pos 1 of group. Let's check: B, C, A = letters 2, 3, 1. For n=5: E, F, G -> F, G, E = 6, 7, 5. For n=9: I, J, K -> J, K, I = 10, 11, 9. For n=13: M, N, O -> N(14), O(15), M(13) -> NOM.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter: B, E, I, N, T, ?
What is the missing pair: AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
questions.explanation: First letters count up: A, B, C, D -> E. Second letters count down: Z, Y, X, W -> V. Next pair is EV.

questions.questionText: Determine the missing cluster: EJO, INS, HMR, GLQ, ?
questions.explanation: First letter: E, I, H, G? Wait: look at E(5), H(8), K(11)? Look at: EJO: 5, 10, 15 (multiples of 5). INS: 9, 14, 19? Gaps: E to I is +4? Let's check: HMR: 8, 13, 18. GLQ: 7, 12, 17. The first letter counts down: I(9), H(8), G(7) -> F(6). If sequence is: (9, 14, 19), (8, 13, 18), (7, 12, 17) -> next is (6, 11, 16) = F, K, P.

questions.questionText: Find the next term: A, B, D, G, K, P, ?
questions.explanation: Differences: +1, +2, +3, +4, +5. Next difference is +6: P(16) + 6 = V(22).

questions.questionText: What comes next in the sequence: D, F, I, M, R, ?
Identify the missing term: WX, UV, ST, QR, ?
questions.explanation: Pairs of consecutive letters in descending blocks: WX(23, 24), UV(21, 22), ST(19, 20), QR(17, 18). First letters decrease by 2: 23, 21, 19, 17 -> 15 (O). Second letter is P(16). Next pair is OP.

questions.questionText: Find the next letter in the Fibonacci-position series: A, A, B, C, E, H, ?
questions.explanation: Alphabet positions correspond to the Fibonacci numbers: 1(A), 1(A), 2(B), 3(C), 5(E), 8(H). The next Fibonacci number is 5 + 8 = 13, which corresponds to M.

questions.questionText: Determine the missing group: KMT, IPQ, GSN, ?
questions.explanation: First letter: K(11)-2=I(9)-2=G(7)-2=E(5). Middle letter: M(13)+3=P(16)+3=S(19)+3=V(22). Last letter: T(20)-3=Q(17)-3=N(14)-3=K(11). Next group is EVK.

questions.questionText: What is the next letter: B, F, J, N, R, ?
questions.explanation: Letters advance by 4 steps: B(2)+4=F(6); F(6)+4=J(10); J(10)+4=N(14); N(14)+4=R(18). Next letter is R(18)+4 = V(22).

questions.questionText: Identify the next pair: ZA, YC, XE, WG, ?
questions.explanation: First letter: Z, Y, X, W -> V (-1). Second letter: A(1)+2=C(3)+2=E(5)+2=G(7)+2=I(9). Next pair is VI.

questions.questionText: Find the missing term: DFH, JLN, PRT, ?
questions.explanation: Each group consists of letters separated by 2 steps: D(4), F(6), H(8). Jump between groups: H(8) to J(10) is +2. Next group starts at T(20)+2 = V(22). Group is V(22), X(24), Z(26) -> VXZ.
questions.concept: Continuous Even Progression in Groups of Three

questions.questionText: What comes next in the sequence: Z, S, M, H, ?
questions.explanation: Decrements: Z(26)-7=S(19); S(19)-6=M(13); M(13)-5=H(8). Decrement reduces by 1 each step (-7, -6, -5). Next decrement is -4: H(8) - 4 = D(4).

questions.questionText: Determine the missing cluster: 2B, 4D, 8H, 16P, ?
questions.explanation: Numbers double: 2, 4, 8, 16 -> 32. Letters: B(2)*2=D(4)*2=H(8)*2=P(16)*2=32 -> 32 mod 26 = 6 = F. Next cluster is 32F.
